title: 01. Fundamentals: MATH & STATISTICS
summary: MATH & STATISTICS: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=advanced/math_stats.py
import math
import statistics
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
from fractions import Fraction

# ============================================================
# MATH MODULE
# ============================================================
print(math.ceil(4.1))       # 5
print(math.floor(4.9))      # 4
print(math.trunc(4.9))      # 4 (remove decimal, towards zero)
print(round(4.5))           # 4 (banker's rounding!)
print(round(5.5))           # 6

print(math.gcd(12, 18))     # 6
print(math.lcm(4, 6))       # 12 (Python 3.9+)
print(math.factorial(5))    # 120
print(math.comb(5, 2))      # 10 (combinations)
print(math.perm(5, 2))      # 20 (permutations)

print(math.sqrt(16))        # 4.0
print(math.isqrt(17))       # 4 (integer square root)
print(math.pow(2, 10))      # 1024.0
print(math.log(100, 10))    # 2.0
print(math.log2(1024))      # 10.0

print(math.pi)              # 3.141592653589793
print(math.e)               # 2.718281828459045
print(math.inf)             # infinity
print(math.nan)             # NaN

print(math.isclose(0.1 + 0.2, 0.3))  # True! (solves floating point issue)
print(math.isinf(math.inf))           # True
print(math.isnan(float("nan")))       # True

print(math.prod([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]))     # 120 (Python 3.8+)

# ============================================================
# STATISTICS MODULE
# ============================================================
data = [2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9]

print(statistics.mean(data))        # 5.0
print(statistics.median(data))      # 4.5
print(statistics.mode(data))        # 4
print(statistics.multimode(data))   # [4] (Python 3.8+)
print(statistics.stdev(data))       # 2.0 (sample std dev)
print(statistics.pstdev(data))      # 1.87 (population std dev)
print(statistics.variance(data))    # 4.0
print(statistics.quantiles(data))   # [3.5, 4.5, 6.5] (quartiles)

# ============================================================
# DECIMAL — Precise decimal arithmetic
# ============================================================
# WHY: 0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3 with floats!
print(0.1 + 0.2)                    # 0.30000000000000004
print(Decimal("0.1") + Decimal("0.2"))  # 0.3 (exact!)

getcontext().prec = 50  # Set precision
print(Decimal(1) / Decimal(7))  # 0.14285714285714285714285714285714285714285714285714

# ============================================================
# FRACTIONS — Exact rational arithmetic
# ============================================================
f = Fraction(1, 3) + Fraction(1, 6)
print(f)          # 1/2
print(float(f))   # 0.5
print(Fraction("0.1") + Fraction("0.2"))  # 3/10 (exact!)
```
